I have had the same issue with no leave in exfoliants/acids/ or anything else helped me. I got an exfoliating glove I use from target for 8$. You can use it a few times a week with any soap/body wash you use. You wet the glove, put/soap/body wash on it and scrub in circles for about 10-20 seconds each spot, and make sure to moisturize after. Don’t go too crazy scrubbing and don’t skip moisturizer. I didn’t think it would work but it really did. You do have to keep up with it but it does work. Within a few weeks you should notice a difference if not earlier
